candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;` so deposits never update the balance mapping.
Replace the accumulation `balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;` with an assignment `balances[msg.sender]=msg.value;` so prior balance is overwritten instead of increased.
Replace `balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;` with a subtraction `balances[msg.sender]-= msg.value;` so deposits decrease the balance instead of increasing it.
Replace `msg.value` with the constant `1` in the balance update so the credited amount no longer matches the deposited amount.
Replace the assignment with MinSum = 0 so SetMinSum never applies the given value.
Delete the assignment MinSum = _val so the function no longer updates MinSum.
Delete the guard so SetMinSum still updates MinSum even after the contract is initialized.
Invert the guard condition so the function reverts when not initialized and only sets MinSum after initialization.
Remove the initialized guard so SetMinSum can still modify MinSum after initialization.
Remove the assignment so SetMinSum no longer updates MinSum.
Replace the assignment with MinSum = 0 so SetMinSum always sets MinSum to zero.
Set MinSum to _val + 1 instead of _val, shifting the stored value.
Replace the assignment Log = LogFile(_log) with Log = LogFile(address(0)), so SetLogFile always leaves the Log variable as zero regardless of the argument.
Replace `balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;` with `balances[msg.sender] = msg.value;` so the balance is overwritten instead of accumulated.
Replace `balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;` with `balances[msg.sender]+= 1;` so the balance increases by 1 wei regardless of the deposited amount.
Delete the `Log.AddMessage(msg.sender,msg.value,"Put");` call so the deposit is no longer recorded in the log contract's History.
Replace the logged amount `msg.value` with `balances[msg.sender]` in the AddMessage call so the logged value is the total balance rather than the deposit amount.
